title: Right approximation is inherited by quasicategorical slices
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces, cores and equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and join slices with their projection as in [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration]. Let $A,B$ be quasicategories in a common sufficiently large universe and $G:A\to B$ a functor reflecting equivalence edges. Suppose that for each $a\in A$, $b\in B$ and edge $\psi:b\to G(a)$ there are $v:a'\to a$ and an equivalence $e:b\to G(a')$ with $[G(v)e]=[\psi]$ in $hB$, whose morphism sets are $\pi_0\operatorname{Map}_B(-,-)$. For each $t\in A$, let $G_t:A_{/t}\to B_{/G(t)}$ be the induced functor on join slices. Then $G_t$ reflects equivalences and satisfies right approximation in the slices: for every $a\in A_{/t}$, $b\in B_{/G(t)}$ and edge $\psi:b\to G_t(a)$ there are $v:a'\to a$ in $A_{/t}$ and an equivalence $e:b\to G_t(a')$ in $B_{/G(t)}$ such that $[G_t(v)e]=[\psi]$ in $h(B_{/G(t)})$. This equality is in the slice homotopy category, retaining the compatibility homotopies with the structural maps to $G(t)$. No existence or preservation of limits is assumed.
